title.v: Danh sách dịch vụ đã trả kết quả

options.query: select ma_ttct, ten_ttct%l from dmttct where ma_ct = 'HC1' and status = 1 order by stt

query.text: exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmhccong c on a.ma_hccong = c.ma_hccong', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_hccong', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId

finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) set @strKey = @strFinding
exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmhccong c on a.ma_hccong = c.ma_hccong', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_hccong', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId
